# Version 4.152.0
> **Graphite GPU rendering arrives** · Released September 5, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.152.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.152.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.152.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.200/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.152.0 adds Graphite GPU rendering and backend-neutral asynchronous pixel readback. The Skia m152 release also brings a Silk.NET Vulkan helper, explicit-font rendering on Nano Server, and fixes for pixel, iterator, and uniform-buffer lifetimes. Existing Ganesh APIs remain available and unchanged.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **Skia milestone m152** — Updates the bundled renderer to m152 and VulkanMemoryAllocator to 3.4.0, retaining the Vulkan allocator fallback used by SkiaSharp callers. ([#4651](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4651))
- **Native rendering and cache lifetime corrections** — Includes upstream Ganesh stale-readback and font-rendering stability fixes, m152 servicing updates, and a SkCachedData correction that releases its mutex guard before deleting the object. ([#4538](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4538), [#4568](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4568), [#4808](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4808), [#4925](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4925))

## API Surface

- **Opt-in Graphite GPU backend** — Adds contexts, recorders, recordings, textures, and image caching for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn, including browser WebGPU. Use the explicit record/snap/insert/submit model; shipping Graphite surfaces require asynchronous pixel readback rather than synchronous ReadPixels. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3968](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3968))
- **Callback-based pixel readback across backends** — SKImage and SKSurface.RequestReadPixels provide rescaled RGBA readback. Results are callback-scoped: copy data out to retain it. Raster callbacks run synchronously; Ganesh completion requires submission and CheckAsyncWorkCompletion. Failure returns a null result. ([#4545](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4545))
- **Silk.NET Vulkan integration** — Adds SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET with GRSilkNetBackendContext and typed extension initialization, and makes GRVkExtensions constructible. The package is included in production packing; the SharpVk helper remains available. ([#4527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4527), [#4841](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4841))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Iterators and pixmaps retain their backing owners** — Region iterators keep their source region alive. ExtractSubset and WithColorType/WithColorSpace/WithAlphaType pixmaps retain the ultimate pixel owner, preventing collection while native views still reference its memory. ([#4355](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4355), [#4558](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4558))
- **Owned buffers and consumed streams are released promptly** — Frees the allocated pixel buffer when SKImage.Create fails, disposes the previous uniform data on Reset, and disposes consumed non-memory-backed stream assets when their HarfBuzz blob is released. ([#4455](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4455), [#4783](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4783), [#4710](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4710))
- **Streaming data output avoids an intermediate copy** — SKData.SaveTo writes the native buffer directly on span-capable targets instead of copying each chunk through a managed buffer. .NET Framework and netstandard2.0 retain the buffered path. ([#4550](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4550))
- **Less temporary text storage** — Null-terminated text encoding avoids an intermediate string. SKFourByteTag and HarfBuzzSharp.Tag formatting avoid character boxing, and Font.Shape reuses caller-provided feature arrays rather than copying them. ([#4498](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4498), [#4752](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4752), [#4690](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4690))
- **Lower object setup overhead** — Pre-sizes runtime-effect uniform lookups and caches invariant wrapper-registration reflection checks instead of repeating that work during object setup. ([#4512](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4512), [#4630](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4630))

## Platform

- **Load explicit fonts on Nano Server** — The Nano Server native build uses FreeType so typefaces loaded from files, streams, or data can render. It still has no system-font discovery; applications must load their fonts explicitly. Normal Windows builds retain DirectWrite. — ❤️ [@jeffska](https://github.com/jeffska) ([#4280](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4280))
- **Native debugging assets** — Adds Apple dSYM symbol packages without adding symbols to customer runtime packages, and gives both Android native libraries deterministic build IDs tied to their split-debug files. ([#4846](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4846), [#4843](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4843))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.200

Font.Shape reuses caller-provided feature arrays, and Tag.ToString avoids character boxing. Apple native symbol packages and deterministic Android build IDs improve native diagnostics without changing the bundled HarfBuzz 14.2.1 engine.

## Release Candidate 1 (August 26, 2026)

Release Candidate 1 restored production packing of the Silk.NET helper, added Apple native symbol packages and deterministic Android symbol identity, and reduced shaping and tag-formatting allocations.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.152.0-preview.1.1...v4.152.0-rc.1.26426.14)

## Preview 1 (August 5, 2026)

Preview 1 introduced Graphite, asynchronous RGBA pixel readback, the Silk.NET Vulkan helper, and Nano Server explicit-font support. It also fixed region-iterator and pixmap backing-owner lifetimes.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/compare/v4.151.5...v4.152.0-preview.1.1)
